title: Provider Onboarding Form
description: The form accessed from the action card on the dashboard home, collecting all Provider Profile fields in one scrolling view with guidance on headshot specs and bio format, submitting back to the dashboard.
html:
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap');

  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

  .form-root {
    font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
    min-height: 100vh;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 240px 1fr;
    grid-template-rows: auto 1fr;
    background: #0f0e1a;
    color: #fff;
  }

  /* TOP NAV */
  .dash-topnav {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 0 32px;
    height: 60px;
    background: rgba(15,14,26,0.95);
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 10;
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  }

  .dash-topnav__left {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 20px;
  }

  .dash-topnav__wordmark { opacity: 0.85; }

  .dash-topnav__divider {
    width: 1px;
    height: 20px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
  }

  .dash-topnav__breadcrumb {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    font-size: 13px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35);
    font-weight: 500;
  }

  .dash-topnav__breadcrumb a {
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35);
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: color 0.15s;
  }

  .dash-topnav__breadcrumb a:hover { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65); }

  .dash-topnav__breadcrumb__sep {
    opacity: 0.3;
  }

  .dash-topnav__breadcrumb__current {
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65);
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  .dash-topnav__right {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
  }

  .dash-topnav__name {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
  }

  .dash-topnav__avatar {
    width: 32px;
    height: 32px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.2);
    border: 1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.3);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #a78bfa;
  }

  /* SIDEBAR */
  .dash-sidebar {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #141222 0%, #110f1f 100%);
    border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    padding: 28px 0;
    gap: 4px;
  }

  .dash-sidebar__section {
    padding: 0 16px 16px;
  }

  .dash-sidebar__section-label {
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
    padding: 0 8px 8px;
    display: block;
  }

  .dash-nav-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    padding: 9px 12px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.15s;
    border: none;
    background: none;
    width: 100%;
    text-align: left;
    font-family: inherit;
  }

  .dash-nav-item[data-active="true"] {
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.12);
    color: #c4b5fd;
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  .dash-nav-item__icon {
    width: 18px;
    height: 18px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    opacity: 0.7;
  }

  .dash-nav-item[data-active="true"] .dash-nav-item__icon { opacity: 1; }

  .dash-nav-item__badge {
    margin-left: auto;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 700;
    padding: 2px 7px;
    border-radius: 100px;
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.2);
    color: #a78bfa;
  }

  /* Sidebar stage widget */
  .sidebar-stage {
    margin: 0 16px 24px;
    padding: 14px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
    border-radius: 12px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .sidebar-stage__label {
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
  }

  .sidebar-stage__name {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
  }

  .sidebar-stage__track { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }

  .sidebar-stage__step { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 12px; }

  .sidebar-stage__dot {
    width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .sidebar-stage__dot[data-state="done"] { background: #4ade80; }
  .sidebar-stage__dot[data-state="active"] { background: #a78bfa; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(167,139,250,0.2); }
  .sidebar-stage__dot[data-state="pending"] { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); }

  .sidebar-stage__step-label[data-state="done"] { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); text-decoration: line-through; }
  .sidebar-stage__step-label[data-state="active"] { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85); font-weight: 600; }
  .sidebar-stage__step-label[data-state="pending"] { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); }

  /* MAIN */
  .form-main {
    overflow-y: auto;
    padding: 48px 64px 80px;
    background: #0f0e1a;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0;
  }

  /* Form page header */
  .form-page-header {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-bottom: 36px;
  }

  .form-page-header__back {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
    font-size: 13px;
    font-family: inherit;
    font-weight: 500;
    padding: 0;
    width: fit-content;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
    transition: color 0.15s;
  }

  .form-page-header__back:hover { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); }

  .form-page-header__eyebrow {
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
  }

  .form-page-header__title {
    font-size: 28px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    color: #fff;
  }

  .form-page-header__desc {
    font-size: 15px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45);
    line-height: 1.6;
    max-width: 560px;
    margin-top: 4px;
  }

  /* Approval notice */
  .approval-notice {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 12px;
    padding: 14px 18px;
    background: rgba(251,191,36,0.07);
    border: 1px solid rgba(251,191,36,0.18);
    border-radius: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 36px;
  }

  .approval-notice__icon {
    flex-shrink: 0;
    margin-top: 1px;
  }

  .approval-notice__text {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 2px;
  }

  .approval-notice__title {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: rgba(251,191,36,0.9);
  }

  .approval-notice__body {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: rgba(251,191,36,0.55);
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  /* Two-column form layout */
  .form-layout {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 320px;
    gap: 40px;
    align-items: start;
  }

  .form-fields {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0;
  }

  /* Section */
  .form-section {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 24px;
    padding-bottom: 36px;
    margin-bottom: 36px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
  }

  .form-section:last-child {
    border-bottom: none;
    margin-bottom: 0;
    padding-bottom: 0;
  }

  .form-section__header {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 3px;
  }

  .form-section__title {
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
  }

  .form-section__desc {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35);
    line-height: 1.4;
  }

  /* Field */
  .form-field {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .form-field--two-col {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 16px;
  }

  .form-field__label {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
  }

  .form-field__required {
    color: rgba(167,139,250,0.7);
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1;
  }

  .form-field__hint {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  .form-field__hint strong {
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
  }

  /* Field inputs */
  .form-input {
    width: 100%;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    border-radius: 11px;
    padding: 0 16px;
    height: 48px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    font-size: 14px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8);
    font-family: inherit;
  }

  .form-input[data-focused="true"] {
    border-color: rgba(167,139,250,0.55);
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.05);
  }

  .form-input[data-filled="true"] {
    border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
  }

  .form-input__cursor {
    width: 1.5px;
    height: 16px;
    background: #a78bfa;
    border-radius: 1px;
    margin-right: 1px;
    display: inline-block;
    animation: blink 1s step-end infinite;
  }

  @keyframes blink {
    0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
    50% { opacity: 0; }
  }

  .form-input--placeholder {
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.22);
  }

  .form-textarea {
    width: 100%;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    border-radius: 11px;
    padding: 14px 16px;
    min-height: 110px;
    font-size: 14px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8);
    font-family: inherit;
    resize: none;
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }

  .form-textarea--placeholder {
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.22);
  }

  /* Headshot upload area */
  .headshot-upload {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 12px;
  }

  .headshot-upload__zone {
    border: 2px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    border-radius: 14px;
    padding: 32px 24px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    text-align: center;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: border-color 0.15s, background 0.15s;
  }

  .headshot-upload__zone:hover {
    border-color: rgba(167,139,250,0.3);
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.04);
  }

  .headshot-upload__icon {
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.1);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .headshot-upload__label {
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55);
  }

  .headshot-upload__sublabel {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  .headshot-upload__browse {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #a78bfa;
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.2);
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 6px 14px;
    cursor: pointer;
    border: none;
    font-family: inherit;
  }

  .headshot-upload__specs {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 4px;
  }

  .headshot-spec-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
  }

  .headshot-spec-row__dot {
    width: 4px;
    height: 4px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  /* States tags for licensed states */
  .states-input {
    width: 100%;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    border-radius: 11px;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    min-height: 52px;
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 7px;
    align-items: center;
    cursor: text;
  }

  .state-tag {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 5px;
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.15);
    border: 1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.25);
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 3px 9px;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #c4b5fd;
  }

  .state-tag__remove {
    font-size: 14px;
    color: rgba(167,139,250,0.5);
    cursor: pointer;
    line-height: 1;
  }

  .states-input__cursor {
    width: 1.5px;
    height: 14px;
    background: #a78bfa;
    border-radius: 1px;
    animation: blink 1s step-end infinite;
    display: inline-block;
  }

  /* Credentials row */
  .credentials-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 14px;
  }

  /* Sidebar sticky guidance */
  .form-sidebar {
    position: sticky;
    top: 80px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 16px;
  }

  .guidance-card {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
    border-radius: 14px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .guidance-card__header {
    padding: 14px 16px 12px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .guidance-card__header-icon {
    width: 26px;
    height: 26px;
    border-radius: 7px;
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.12);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .guidance-card__title {
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  }

  .guidance-card__body {
    padding: 14px 16px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .guidance-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 9px;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  .guidance-item__dot {
    width: 5px;
    height: 5px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.4);
    flex-shrink: 0;
    margin-top: 6px;
  }

  .guidance-item strong {
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65);
  }

  /* Bio format card */
  .bio-format-card {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 14px 16px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .bio-format-card__label {
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
  }

  .bio-format-card__example {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
    line-height: 1.6;
    font-style: italic;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
    border-left: 2px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.3);
    border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0;
  }

  /* Progress widget in sidebar */
  .form-progress-widget {
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.06);
    border: 1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.15);
    border-radius: 14px;
    padding: 16px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 12px;
  }

  .form-progress-widget__label {
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.07em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: rgba(167,139,250,0.6);
  }

  .form-progress-bar {
    height: 4px;
    border-radius: 2px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .form-progress-bar__fill {
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: 2px;
    background: #7c3aed;
    width: 40%;
  }

  .form-progress-widget__fields {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 6px;
  }

  .form-progress-field-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    font-size: 12px;
  }

  .form-progress-field-row__name {
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
  }

  .form-progress-field-row__status {
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  .form-progress-field-row__status[data-done="true"] { color: #4ade80; }
  .form-progress-field-row__status[data-done="false"] { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); }

  /* Submit area */
  .form-submit-area {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 12px;
    padding-top: 36px;
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    margin-top: 8px;
  }

  .form-submit-btn {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 8px;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 480px;
    padding: 15px 28px;
    border-radius: 13px;
    background: #7c3aed;
    border: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #fff;
    font-family: inherit;
    transition: background 0.15s;
  }

  .form-submit-btn:hover { background: #6d28d9; }

  .form-submit-note {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
    line-height: 1.5;
    max-width: 480px;
  }

  .form-submit-note strong {
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45);
  }
</style>

      <p class="form-page-header__desc" data-el="page-desc">This is what members see when they choose a provider. Fill in all fields — the team will review, edit if needed, and approve before your profile reaches anyone. Once submitted you won't be able to edit it directly; changes go through the team.</p>

    <!-- Approval notice -->
    <div class="approval-notice" data-el="approval-notice">
      <div class="approval-notice__icon">
        <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="rgba(251,191,36,0.8)" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><path d="M12 8v4"/><path d="M12 16h.01"/></svg>
      </div>
      <div class="approval-notice__text">
        <span class="approval-notice__title">Profile Approval required before you're visible to members</span>
        <span class="approval-notice__body">After you submit, the team reviews your headshot and bio in the Admin Console. They may edit your bio for consistency. You'll be notified when your profile is approved and what your next step is.</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Two-column form -->
    <div class="form-layout" data-el="form-layout">

      <!-- LEFT: Form fields -->
      <div class="form-fields" data-el="form-fields">

        <!-- Section: Display info -->
        <div class="form-section" data-el="section-display">
          <div class="form-section__header">
            <span class="form-section__title">Display information</span>
            <span class="form-section__desc">How your name and credentials appear to members in the app</span>
          </div>

          <div class="form-field" data-el="field-display-name">
            <label class="form-field__label">
              Provider Full Display Name
              <span class="form-field__required">*</span>
            </label>
            <div class="form-input" data-focused="true" data-filled="true">
              <span class="form-input__cursor"></span>
              Kristina Mercer, LCSW
            </div>
            <span class="form-field__hint">As it should appear to members in the app — include your credentials here (e.g. Jane Smith, LMFT)</span>
          </div>

          <div class="form-field--two-col">
            <div class="form-field" data-el="field-timezone">
              <label class="form-field__label">
                Provider Timezone
                <span class="form-field__required">*</span>
              </label>
              <div class="form-input" data-filled="true">
                America/New_York
              </div>
              <span class="form-field__hint">e.g. America/Los_Angeles</span>
            </div>

            <div class="form-field" data-el="field-license-type">
              <label class="form-field__label">
                License Type
                <span class="form-field__required">*</span>
              </label>
              <div class="form-input form-input--placeholder">
                e.g. LCSW, LMFT, LPC
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Section: Headshot -->
        <div class="form-section" data-el="section-headshot">
          <div class="form-section__header">
            <span class="form-section__title">Headshot photo</span>
            <span class="form-section__desc">The team will download your photo, edit it for consistency, and upload the final version during Profile Approval</span>
          </div>

          <div class="headshot-upload" data-el="headshot-upload">
            <div class="headshot-upload__zone">
              <div class="headshot-upload__icon">
                <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" style="color:#a78bfa;" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2"/><circle cx="9" cy="9" r="2"/><path d="m21 15-3.09-3.09a2 2 0 0 0-2.82 0L6 21"/></svg>
              </div>
              <span class="headshot-upload__label">Drag and drop your headshot here</span>
              <span class="headshot-upload__sublabel">Clear, professional photo. The team will crop and edit it before your profile goes live.</span>
              <button class="headshot-upload__browse" type="button">Browse files</button>
            </div>

            <div class="headshot-upload__specs" data-el="headshot-specs">
              <div class="headshot-spec-row">
                <div class="headshot-spec-row__dot"></div>
                <span>Ideal size: <strong style="color:rgba(255,255,255,0.5);">800×600px</strong></span>
              </div>
              <div class="headshot-spec-row">
                <div class="headshot-spec-row__dot"></div>
                <span>Aspect ratio: roughly <strong style="color:rgba(255,255,255,0.5);">5:4</strong></span>
              </div>
              <div class="headshot-spec-row">
                <div class="headshot-spec-row__dot"></div>
                <span>File types: JPG or PNG, under 10MB</span>
              </div>
              <div class="headshot-spec-row">
                <div class="headshot-spec-row__dot"></div>
                <span>Face visible, professional background, good lighting</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Section: Bio and quote -->
        <div class="form-section" data-el="section-bio">
          <div class="form-section__header">
            <span class="form-section__title">Bio and quote</span>
            <span class="form-section__desc">The team edits bios by hand during Profile Approval to keep them consistent across all providers</span>
          </div>

          <div class="form-field" data-el="field-bio">
            <label class="form-field__label">
              Provider Professional Bio
              <span class="form-field__required">*</span>
            </label>
            <div class="form-textarea" data-el="bio-textarea">
              <span style="color:rgba(255,255,255,0.22);">Short plain-text bio: your credentials, license type, and specialties. The team will edit this for format and length. Write naturally — don't worry about getting it perfect.</span>
            </div>
            <span class="form-field__hint"><strong>Keep it to 3–4 sentences.</strong> Credentials, license type, areas of focus, and what you bring to sessions. No first-person marketing language. The team edits for a consistent format across all providers.</span>
          </div>

          <div class="form-field" data-el="field-quote">
            <label class="form-field__label">
              Provider Quote
              <span class="form-field__required">*</span>
            </label>
            <div class="form-input form-input--placeholder">
              A short quote displayed under your photo
            </div>
            <span class="form-field__hint">One sentence. Something genuine about your approach to care, or what brings you to this work.</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Section: Licensed states -->
        <div class="form-section" data-el="section-states">
          <div class="form-section__header">
            <span class="form-section__title">Licensed states</span>
            <span class="form-section__desc">Members only see you in states where you're licensed. This controls your visibility in Provider Booking.</span>
          </div>

          <div class="form-field" data-el="field-states">
            <label class="form-field__label">
              Provider License State Coverage
              <span class="form-field__required">*</span>
            </label>
            <div class="states-input" data-el="states-input">
              <div class="state-tag">
                NY
                <span class="state-tag__remove">×</span>
              </div>
              <div class="state-tag">
                NJ
                <span class="state-tag__remove">×</span>
              </div>
              <div class="state-tag">
                CT
                <span class="state-tag__remove">×</span>
              </div>
              <span class="states-input__cursor"></span>
            </div>
            <span class="form-field__hint">Every state you are licensed to practice in. Type a state abbreviation and press Enter to add it.</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Section: Credentials -->
        <div class="form-section" data-el="section-credentials">
          <div class="form-section__header">
            <span class="form-section__title">Credentials</span>
            <span class="form-section__desc">Used on your profile and in member-facing booking. Add each credential you hold.</span>
          </div>

          <div class="form-field" data-el="field-credentials">
            <label class="form-field__label">
              Credentials
              <span class="form-field__required">*</span>
            </label>
            <div class="credentials-grid" data-el="credentials-grid">
              <div class="form-input" data-filled="true">LCSW</div>
              <div class="form-input form-input--placeholder">Add credential</div>
              <div class="form-input form-input--placeholder">Add credential</div>
            </div>
            <span class="form-field__hint">e.g. LCSW, PhD, LMFT — add one per box. These appear on your profile and help members filter by credential type.</span>
          </div>
        </div>

            Submit Provider Onboarding Form
          </button>
          <p class="form-submit-note" data-el="submit-note">
            <strong>You won't be able to edit your profile after submitting.</strong> The team reviews and approves all profiles before they reach members. If you need to make changes after submission, contact the provider ops team.

          <div class="guidance-card__header">
            <div class="guidance-card__header-icon">
              <svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" style="color:#a78bfa;" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2"/><circle cx="9" cy="9" r="2"/><path d="m21 15-3.09-3.09a2 2 0 0 0-2.82 0L6 21"/></svg>
            </div>
            <span class="guidance-card__title">Headshot guidance</span>
          </div>
          <div class="guidance-card__body">
            <div class="guidance-item">
              <div class="guidance-item__dot"></div>
              <span><strong>800×600px</strong> ideal. Minimum 400×300px. Roughly 5:4 ratio.</span>
            </div>
            <div class="guidance-item">
              <div class="guidance-item__dot"></div>
              <span><strong>Face clearly visible</strong>, centered, with a clean or neutral background.</span>
            </div>
            <div class="guidance-item">
              <div class="guidance-item__dot"></div>
              <span><strong>Professional attire.</strong> Good natural or soft studio lighting.</span>
            </div>
            <div class="guidance-item">
              <div class="guidance-item__dot"></div>
              <span>The team will <strong>download, crop, and adjust</strong> your photo before your profile goes live. You don't need to get it perfect.</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Bio guidance -->
        <div class="guidance-card" data-el="bio-guidance">
          <div class="guidance-card__header">
            <div class="guidance-card__header-icon">
              <svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" style="color:#a78bfa;" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M11 4H4a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v14a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h14a2 2 0 0 0 2-2v-7"/><path d="M18.5 2.5a2.121 2.121 0 0 1 3 3L12 15l-4 1 1-4 9.5-9.5z"/></svg>
            </div>
            <span class="guidance-card__title">Bio format</span>
          </div>
          <div class="guidance-card__body">
            <div class="guidance-item">
              <div class="guidance-item__dot"></div>
              <span><strong>3–4 sentences.</strong> Credentials and license type first, then specialties, then what you bring to sessions.</span>
            </div>
            <div class="guidance-item">
              <div class="guidance-item__dot"></div>
              <span>Plain text only. <strong>No markdown, no bullet points.</strong></span>
            </div>
            <div class="guidance-item">
              <div class="guidance-item__dot"></div>
              <span>Write in third person (e.g. "Kristina is…"). The team edits for consistency.</span>
            </div>

            <div class="bio-format-card" data-el="bio-example">
              <span class="bio-format-card__label">Example format</span>
              <p class="bio-format-card__example">"Kristina Mercer is a licensed clinical social worker with over eight years of experience in cognitive behavioral therapy and trauma-informed care. She specializes in anxiety, life transitions, and relationship dynamics. Kristina brings a collaborative, goal-oriented approach to her sessions."</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- What happens next -->
        <div class="guidance-card" data-el="what-happens-next">
          <div class="guidance-card__header">
            <div class="guidance-card__header-icon">
              <svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" style="color:#a78bfa;" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><polyline points="12 6 12 12 16 14"/></svg>
            </div>
            <span class="guidance-card__title">What happens after you submit</span>
          </div>
          <div class="guidance-card__body">
            <div class="guidance-item">
              <div class="guidance-item__dot"></div>
              <span>The <strong>Provider Ops Rotation</strong> gets an email alert and opens your profile in the Admin Console.</span>
            </div>
            <div class="guidance-item">
              <div class="guidance-item__dot"></div>
              <span>They review and edit your bio and headshot for consistency, then <strong>approve your profile.</strong></span>
            </div>
            <div class="guidance-item">
              <div class="guidance-item__dot"></div>
              <span>You'll get an <strong>email confirmation</strong> with your next step — Provider Availability Settings.</span>
            </div>
            <div class="guidance-item">
              <div class="guidance-item__dot"></div>
              <span>Once approved, your profile fields are <strong>locked.</strong> Changes go through the team.</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

      </div>

    </div>

  </main>

</div>
